observations: White game console with a horizontal slit dividing the side panels, characteristic of the PS5 Slim model.
A disc drive bulge is visible on the lower right panel in photo 0.
The console is being held by a person wearing a black watch with red stitching.
Photo 1 shows the console in polystyrene packaging with a power cable and a manual.
The manual in photo 1 has 'PS5' printed on it along with Japanese text.
Photo 2 shows the PlayStation logo on the top panel.
A single white controller (DualSense) is partially visible in the background of photo 2, wrapped in plastic.
The background shows a paved outdoor area and some wooden/cardboard materials.

claims.evidence: The four-panel design with the center slit in photos 0 and 2 is unique to the Slim model.
Requires a screenshot of the console's storage or home screen.
Only one controller is partially visible in photo 2.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be defective.
